Name: Default
Description: All built-in sample rules for credentials, keys, cloud accounts, infrastructure, endpoints and personal data.

Rules.Name: Private key block (PEM / OpenSSH / PGP)
Rules.Description: RSA, EC, DSA, OpenSSH, PKCS#8 (encrypted or not) and PGP private keys. The BEGIN/END lines are kept so readers know what was there; the key body is replaced line by line.
Rules.Pattern: -----BEGIN[ A-Z0-9]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----(?<secret>[\s\S]+?)-----END[ A-Z0-9]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----

Rules.Name: PuTTY private key (.ppk)
Rules.Description: The private part of a PuTTY key file.

Rules.Name: Certificate block (PEM)
Rules.Description: Certificates are public, but they name your servers, organisation and internal CA. Body replaced, BEGIN/END kept.
Rules.Pattern: -----BEGIN (?:CERTIFICATE|TRUSTED CERTIFICATE|X509 CRL|CERTIFICATE REQUEST|NEW CERTIFICATE REQUEST|PKCS7)-----(?<secret>[\s\S]+?)-----END (?:CERTIFICATE|TRUSTED CERTIFICATE|X509 CRL|CERTIFICATE REQUEST|NEW CERTIFICATE REQUEST|PKCS7)-----

Rules.Name: SSH public key
Rules.Description: authorized_keys / known_hosts entries. Public, but they identify people and machines (the user@host comment is replaced too).

Rules.Name: JSON Web Token (JWT)
Rules.Description: Signed tokens (often access or ID tokens) copied into code, tests or HTTP files.

Rules.Name: ASP.NET <machineKey> validation / decryption key
Rules.Description: web.config machineKey values (used to sign/encrypt view state, forms auth cookies).

Rules.Name: Kubernetes kubeconfig key / certificate data
Rules.Description: Base64 client keys, certificates and tokens inside kubeconfig files.

Rules.Name: Kubernetes Secret data values
Rules.Description: Base64 values in YAML (as used in kind: Secret manifests and Helm values). Only applied to YAML files and only to values that look random.

Rules.Name: Certificate thumbprint
Rules.Description: SHA-1/SHA-256 certificate thumbprints (they identify certificates in your stores).

Rules.Name: Certificate / keystore password
Rules.Description: Passwords for .pfx/.p12 files, Java keystores and code-signing certificates.

Rules.Name: Hard-coded key as a byte array
Rules.Description: 16+ hex bytes in a row, the usual way AES keys, IVs and salts are pasted into code.

Rules.Name: age encryption secret key
Rules.Description: Secret keys for the age file encryption tool.

Rules.Name: Long Base64 blob
Rules.Description: Very long Base64 strings (embedded keys, certificates, packed config). Off by default: it also hits images and fonts embedded in CSS/HTML.

Rules.Name: Any GUID
Rules.Description: Every GUID. Off by default (project and COM GUIDs are everywhere); the Azure rules already catch tenant, subscription and client ids by context.

Rules.Name: AWS access key id
Rules.Description: AWS access key ids (AKIA... long-term, ASIA... temporary) and other IAM unique ids.

Rules.Name: AWS secret access key
Rules.Description: The 40-character secret that goes with an access key id.

Rules.Name: AWS session token
Rules.Description: Temporary STS session tokens.

Rules.Name: AWS account id in ARN
Rules.Description: 12-digit account ids inside Amazon Resource Names (the rest of the ARN is kept).

Rules.Name: AWS account id setting
Rules.Description: aws_account_id = 123456789012 style settings.

Rules.Name: AWS resource endpoint (RDS, ELB, API Gateway, ECR...)
Rules.Description: Hostnames that name YOUR resources, such as mydb.abc123.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com or 123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com. Plain service endpoints (s3.amazonaws.com, sts.us-east-1.amazonaws.com) are left alone.

Rules.Name: S3 bucket name
Rules.Description: Bucket names in s3:// URIs and S3 URLs.

Rules.Name: CloudFront distribution host
Rules.Description: CloudFront distribution hostnames.

Rules.Name: Amazon MWS auth token
Rules.Description: Amazon Marketplace Web Service tokens.

Rules.Name: Azure storage / Cosmos DB account key
Rules.Description: 88-character Base64 keys for storage accounts and Cosmos DB (AccountKey=... in connection strings).

Rules.Name: Azure storage account name
Rules.Description: AccountName=... in storage connection strings.

Rules.Name: Azure Service Bus / Event Hubs / IoT shared access key
Rules.Description: SharedAccessKey=... in Service Bus, Event Hubs, Relay and IoT Hub connection strings.

Rules.Name: Azure SAS token signature (sig=)
Rules.Description: The signature part of shared access signature URLs and tokens.

Rules.Name: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) client secret
Rules.Description: App registration client secrets (they contain Q~ at the 5th/6th character).

Rules.Name: Azure tenant / subscription / client id
Rules.Description: GUIDs assigned to TenantId, SubscriptionId, ClientId/AppId and similar names.

Rules.Name: Azure subscription in resource id / URL
Rules.Description: Subscription ids and resource group names in /subscriptions/.../resourceGroups/... paths.

Rules.Name: Tenant id in login URL
Rules.Description: Tenant ids or onmicrosoft.com names in authority URLs.

Rules.Name: Tenant name (*.onmicrosoft.com)
Rules.Description: Tenant domains, SharePoint sites and B2C login hosts.

Rules.Name: Application Insights instrumentation key
Rules.Description: Application Insights keys (also in APPLICATIONINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING).

Rules.Name: Azure Functions key (code=)
Rules.Description: Function keys passed in ?code= query strings or the x-functions-key header.

Rules.Name: Azure DevOps personal access token
Rules.Description: Azure DevOps PATs in settings or inside git remote URLs.

Rules.Name: Azure resource host (storage, SQL, Key Vault, App Service...)
Rules.Description: Hostnames that name your own Azure resources, e.g. contosoprod.blob.core.windows.net, sales-sql.database.windows.net, kv-prod.vault.azure.net.

Rules.Name: Azure DevOps organisation URL
Rules.Description: Organisation names in dev.azure.com/... and *.visualstudio.com URLs.

Rules.Name: Google API key
Rules.Description: Google Cloud / Maps / Firebase / Gemini API keys.

Rules.Name: Google OAuth client secret
Rules.Description: OAuth 2.0 client secrets for Google sign-in.

Rules.Name: Google OAuth client id
Rules.Description: OAuth client ids (identify your Google Cloud project).

Rules.Name: Google service account private_key_id
Rules.Description: The key id inside service-account JSON files (the private key itself is caught by the PEM rule).

Rules.Name: Google service account email
Rules.Description: Service accounts reveal the project id and purpose.

Rules.Name: Google Cloud / Firebase app host
Rules.Description: Firebase databases, App Engine, Cloud Run and Cloud Functions hostnames.

Rules.Name: Google Cloud project id setting
Rules.Description: GCP project ids in settings and Terraform.

Rules.Name: Firebase Cloud Messaging server key
Rules.Description: Legacy FCM server keys.

Rules.Name: DigitalOcean token
Rules.Description: DigitalOcean personal access, OAuth and refresh tokens.

Rules.Name: Alibaba Cloud access key id
Rules.Description: Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun) AccessKey ids.

Rules.Name: IBM Cloud / Oracle Cloud key setting
Rules.Description: IBM Cloud API keys and Oracle Cloud tenancy/user OCIDs.

Rules.Name: Oracle Cloud OCID
Rules.Description: Oracle Cloud resource identifiers.

Rules.Name: Authorization header value
Rules.Description: The credential part of Authorization: Bearer/Basic/Token ... headers (code, .http files, Postman, curl).

Rules.Name: Bearer token
Rules.Description: Any 'Bearer xxxx' string with a long token after it.

Rules.Name: AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", "...")
Rules.Description: .NET HttpClient headers with a hard-coded token.

Rules.Name: API key header (x-api-key, Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key...)
Rules.Description: Common API-key headers used by API gateways and SaaS services.

Rules.Name: GitHub token
Rules.Description: GitHub personal access (classic and fine-grained), OAuth, app and refresh tokens.

Rules.Name: GitLab token
Rules.Description: GitLab personal, deploy, runner, pipeline trigger and other tokens.

Rules.Name: Bitbucket / Atlassian API token
Rules.Description: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket) API tokens and app passwords.

Rules.Name: npm access token
Rules.Description: npm automation / publish tokens.

Rules.Name: PyPI upload token
Rules.Description: PyPI API tokens.

Rules.Name: NuGet API key
Rules.Description: nuget.org API keys.

Rules.Name: Docker Hub token
Rules.Description: Docker Hub personal / organisation access tokens.

Rules.Name: Docker config.json auth
Rules.Description: Base64 user:password pairs and identity tokens in ~/.docker/config.json.

Rules.Name: JFrog Artifactory token
Rules.Description: Artifactory API keys and reference tokens.

Rules.Name: Terraform Cloud / Enterprise token
Rules.Description: HCP Terraform API tokens.

Rules.Name: HashiCorp Vault token
Rules.Description: Vault service, batch and recovery tokens.

Rules.Name: Pulumi access token
Rules.Description: Pulumi Cloud access tokens.

Rules.Name: Doppler token
Rules.Description: Doppler secrets-manager tokens.

Rules.Name: Postman API key
Rules.Description: Postman API keys.

Rules.Name: Snyk / SonarQube token
Rules.Description: SonarQube user/project/analysis tokens and Snyk tokens.

Rules.Name: CircleCI / Buildkite token
Rules.Description: CircleCI personal tokens and Buildkite agent tokens.

Rules.Name: Stripe secret / restricted key
Rules.Description: Stripe secret and restricted API keys.

Rules.Name: Stripe publishable key
Rules.Description: Publishable keys are meant for browsers but still identify your account.

Rules.Name: Stripe webhook signing secret
Rules.Description: Webhook endpoint signing secrets.

Rules.Name: Square access token / secret
Rules.Description: Square access tokens and OAuth secrets.

Rules.Name: Braintree / PayPal access token
Rules.Description: Braintree gateway access tokens.

Rules.Name: Shopify token
Rules.Description: Shopify admin, custom app, private app tokens and shared secrets.

Rules.Name: Slack token
Rules.Description: Slack bot, user, app and configuration tokens.

Rules.Name: Slack incoming webhook URL
Rules.Description: Anyone with this URL can post into your Slack channel.

Rules.Name: Microsoft Teams / Office 365 webhook URL
Rules.Description: Incoming webhooks and Power Automate trigger URLs for Teams.

Rules.Name: Discord webhook URL
Rules.Description: Discord channel webhooks.

Rules.Name: Discord bot token
Rules.Description: Discord bot tokens.

Rules.Name: Telegram bot token
Rules.Description: Telegram Bot API tokens.

Rules.Name: Twilio API key / account SID
Rules.Description: Twilio API key SIDs (SK...) and account SIDs (AC...).

Rules.Name: SendGrid API key
Rules.Description: SendGrid email API keys.

Rules.Name: Mailgun API key
Rules.Description: Mailgun private API keys.

Rules.Name: Mailchimp API key
Rules.Description: Mailchimp marketing API keys.

Rules.Name: Postmark / Mandrill / Brevo key
Rules.Description: Brevo (Sendinblue) and Mandrill API keys.

Rules.Name: Notion integration token
Rules.Description: Notion internal integration secrets.

Rules.Name: Linear API key
Rules.Description: Linear API keys.

Rules.Name: Airtable / Figma / Asana token
Rules.Description: Airtable personal access tokens, Figma tokens and Asana PATs.

Rules.Name: Sentry DSN / token
Rules.Description: Sentry DSNs (contain the project key) and auth tokens.

Rules.Name: New Relic key
Rules.Description: New Relic user, ingest, browser and license keys.

Rules.Name: Datadog API / application key
Rules.Description: Datadog keys (recognised by their setting name).

Rules.Name: Grafana token
Rules.Description: Grafana service account and Grafana Cloud tokens.

Rules.Name: Splunk HEC token
Rules.Description: Splunk HTTP Event Collector tokens.

Rules.Name: Dynatrace token
Rules.Description: Dynatrace API tokens.

Rules.Name: OpenAI API key
Rules.Description: OpenAI project, service-account, admin and legacy keys.

Rules.Name: Anthropic API key
Rules.Description: Anthropic (Claude) API and admin keys.

Rules.Name: Hugging Face token
Rules.Description: Hugging Face user access tokens.

Rules.Name: Groq / xAI / Perplexity / Replicate key
Rules.Description: Keys for other AI APIs.

Rules.Name: Databricks token
Rules.Description: Databricks personal access tokens.

Rules.Name: Supabase / PlanetScale token
Rules.Description: Supabase management/secret keys and PlanetScale passwords/tokens.

Rules.Name: Mapbox secret token
Rules.Description: Mapbox secret access tokens.

Rules.Name: Dropbox token
Rules.Description: Dropbox short-lived access tokens.

Rules.Name: Facebook / Twitter (X) token
Rules.Description: Facebook Graph access tokens and Twitter/X app bearer tokens.

Rules.Name: Okta API token
Rules.Description: Okta API tokens in SSWS authorisation headers.

Rules.Name: Cloudflare / Heroku / Vercel / Netlify token setting
Rules.Description: Tokens for many platforms that have no fixed prefix, recognised by their setting name (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, HEROKU_API_KEY, VERCEL_TOKEN...).

Rules.Name: Password in code / quoted setting
Rules.Description: A quoted value assigned to a name ending in password, passwd, pwd, passphrase... in any language or JSON/YAML/XML.

Rules.Name: Password in config file (unquoted)
Rules.Description: NAME=value / name: value lines in .env, .ini, .properties, YAML, shell scripts and similar files.

Rules.Name: Password in connection string
Rules.Description: Password=... or Pwd=... inside SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle and ODBC connection strings.

Rules.Name: Secret in <add key=... value=...>
Rules.Description: app.config / web.config / NuGet.config entries like <add key="SmtpPassword" value="..."/>.

Rules.Name: Secret in XML element
Rules.Description: Values inside elements such as <Password>...</Password>, <ApiKey>...</ApiKey> (Maven settings.xml, .pubxml, FileZilla, etc.).

Rules.Name: User name in code / quoted setting
Rules.Description: A quoted value assigned to user, username, login, uid, serviceAccount... Common built-in names (admin, root, sa...) are ignored.

Rules.Name: User name in config file (unquoted)
Rules.Description: NAME=value / name: value user name lines in .env, .ini, .properties, YAML, shell scripts and similar files.

Rules.Name: User name in connection string
Rules.Description: User Id=..., UID=..., User=... inside connection strings.

Rules.Name: Windows DOMAIN\user account
Rules.Description: Down-level logon names such as CONTOSO\jsmith or CONTOSO\\svc_app (both the domain and the user are replaced).

Rules.Name: Service account / UPN
Rules.Description: User principal names of service accounts such as svc_backup@contoso.com.

Rules.Name: Secret / token / API key in code
Rules.Description: A quoted value without spaces assigned to a name ending in secret, apiKey, token, accessKey, privateKey, salt... (publicKeyToken, tokenType, keyVaultName and similar names are skipped).

Rules.Name: Secret / token / API key in config file (unquoted)
Rules.Description: NAME=value / name: value secret lines in .env, .ini, .properties, YAML, .npmrc and similar files.

Rules.Name: High-entropy value assigned to key-like name
Rules.Description: Catches random-looking strings (keys, hashes, tokens) assigned to anything with key/secret/token/hash/sig in its name.

Rules.Name: new NetworkCredential(user, password)
Rules.Description: .NET NetworkCredential created with hard-coded user name, password and optional domain.

Rules.Name: Basic auth built from user:password
Rules.Description: Code that Base64-encodes a hard-coded "user:password" string for an Authorization header.

Rules.Name: PowerShell ConvertTo-SecureString -AsPlainText
Rules.Description: Plain-text passwords turned into SecureString objects in PowerShell scripts.

Rules.Name: Password / token passed as a command-line argument
Rules.Description: Arguments like --password X, -Password 'X', /p:Password=X, -storepass X in scripts, Dockerfiles and CI files.

Rules.Name: sqlcmd / bcp / mysql password switch
Rules.Description: sqlcmd -P password, bcp -P password, mysql -pPassword.

Rules.Name: curl -u user:password
Rules.Description: curl/wget calls with embedded credentials.

Rules.Name: net use / runas /user:
Rules.Description: User names passed to net use, runas, psexec, schtasks and cmdkey.

Rules.Name: Credentials in mount / fstab options
Rules.Description: username=, password= and domain= options of mount -o and /etc/fstab CIFS/SMB entries.

Rules.Name: sshpass -p password
Rules.Description: Passwords handed to ssh through sshpass.

Rules.Name: SNMP community string
Rules.Description: SNMP community strings in device configs, monitoring settings and scripts.

Rules.Name: Wi-Fi / VPN pre-shared key
Rules.Description: Wireless passphrases and IPsec/IKE pre-shared keys.

Rules.Name: Cisco enable secret / password hash
Rules.Description: Cisco IOS enable secrets and local user passwords (type 0, 5, 7, 8, 9).

Rules.Name: Private IPv4 address (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x)
Rules.Description: Internal addresses reveal your network layout (RFC 1918 and carrier-grade NAT ranges).

Rules.Name: IPv4 address
Rules.Description: Any IPv4 address. 0.0.0.0, 127.0.0.1, 255.255.255.x masks and lines that look like version numbers are skipped.

Rules.Name: IPv6 address
Rules.Description: Full and compressed IPv6 addresses (::1 and fe80:: link-local are skipped).

Rules.Name: MAC address
Rules.Description: Network card hardware addresses (identify physical machines).

Rules.Name: Internal host name (.local, .corp, .internal, .lan...)
Rules.Description: Fully qualified names in private DNS zones, e.g. sql01.corp.contoso.local or build.internal.

Rules.Name: Kubernetes service DNS name
Rules.Description: service.namespace.svc.cluster.local names reveal cluster layout.

Rules.Name: Server / host in connection string
Rules.Description: Server=..., Data Source=..., Host=..., Failover Partner=... in database, Redis and message-bus connection strings.

Rules.Name: Database name in connection string
Rules.Description: Database=... / Initial Catalog=... names.

Rules.Name: Host / server name in code or settings
Rules.Description: Quoted values assigned to host, server, smtpServer, dbHost, bootstrapServers, bastion...

Rules.Name: Server passed as a command-line argument
Rules.Description: Host names in PowerShell (-ComputerName, -ServerInstance...), WMIC (/node:) and CLI (--host) arguments.

Rules.Name: Host / server in config file (unquoted)
Rules.Description: HOST=... / server: ... lines in .env, .ini, .properties, YAML and similar files.

Rules.Name: UNC network path (\\server\share)
Rules.Description: Server and share names in \\fileserver\share paths (single or doubled backslashes).

Rules.Name: SMB / NFS mount source
Rules.Description: //server/share in fstab, mount commands and smb:// URLs.

Rules.Name: Windows user profile path
Rules.Description: C:\Users\<name>\... paths reveal user names.

Rules.Name: Linux / macOS home folder path
Rules.Description: /home/<name>/... and /Users/<name>/... paths reveal user names.

Rules.Name: LDAP / Active Directory distinguished name
Rules.Description: CN=...,OU=...,DC=... paths reveal your directory structure, groups and accounts.

Rules.Name: Database / broker / service connection URI
Rules.Description: URIs such as mongodb+srv://..., postgresql://..., redis://..., amqp://..., jdbc:sqlserver://..., ldap://..., ssh://...

Rules.Name: SSH / SCP user@host
Rules.Description: user@host targets in ssh, scp, sftp and rsync commands.

Rules.Name: Private container registry
Rules.Description: Registry host in image references such as registry.contoso.com:5000/team/api:1.2. Public registries (docker.io, ghcr.io, mcr.microsoft.com, quay.io, gcr.io...) are skipped.

Rules.Name: Terraform backend / state location
Rules.Description: Bucket, storage account, resource group and organisation names in Terraform files.

Rules.Name: Domain / realm name setting
Rules.Description: Quoted values assigned to domain, adDomain, realm, workgroup, forest...

Rules.Name: Hosts in hosts file / nginx / Apache config
Rules.Description: server_name, ServerName/ServerAlias, ssh_config Host/HostName entries.

Rules.Name: Credentials inside a URL (user:password@host)
Rules.Description: Any URL or URI with an embedded user name and password, e.g. https://admin:pa55@host, postgres://app:secret@db:5432.

Rules.Name: Secret in URL query string
Rules.Description: ?api_key=..., &token=..., &password=... and similar query-string parameters.

Rules.Name: URL pointing at an IP address
Rules.Description: http(s)://10.1.2.3:8080/... style URLs (servers reached by address).

Rules.Name: URL with an internal host name
Rules.Description: URLs whose host is in a private DNS zone, e.g. https://jira.corp.contoso.local/browse/ABC-1.

Rules.Name: URL with a single-word host (http://server/...)
Rules.Description: Intranet-style URLs such as http://reportserver/Reports or http://build01:8080.

Rules.Name: Web address / API endpoint
Rules.Description: Every other http(s), ws(s) and ftp URL. Well-known public sites (w3.org, microsoft docs, nuget, npm, CDNs, licences...) are skipped. Turn this off if you only care about secrets.

Rules.Name: gRPC / GraphQL endpoint setting
Rules.Description: Quoted values assigned to endpoint, baseUrl, apiUrl, authority, issuer, audience, redirectUri, webhookUrl...

Rules.Name: Email address
Rules.Description: Email addresses of people, distribution lists and service accounts. example.com/org/net, noreply and git@ addresses are skipped.

Rules.Name: Phone number (international +CC format)
Rules.Description: E.164-style numbers such as +44 20 7946 0958 or +61-2-5550-1234. Off by default (can match arithmetic in code).

Rules.Name: US Social Security Number
Rules.Description: 123-45-6789 style numbers (invalid ranges excluded).

Rules.Name: Credit card number
Rules.Description: Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover and Diners numbers that pass the Luhn checksum. Well-known test numbers (4111 1111 1111 1111 etc.) are skipped.

Rules.Name: Bank account (IBAN)
Rules.Description: International bank account numbers.

Rules.Name: US bank routing / account number setting
Rules.Description: Routing and account numbers in settings, fixtures and seed data.

Rules.Name: Passport / driver licence / national id setting
Rules.Description: Government identifiers by setting name.

Rules.Name: Date of birth
Rules.Description: Dates assigned to dob / dateOfBirth / birthDate.

Rules.Name: Person name in test / seed data
Rules.Description: Quoted values assigned to firstName, lastName, fullName, displayName... Off by default: enable when you have real names in fixtures.

Rules.Name: Street address (US style)
Rules.Description: Street addresses in fixtures and comments. Off by default.

Rules.Name: Company & product names (edit me)
Rules.Description: Exact text, one per line. Replace these examples with your company, subsidiary, client and product names.

Rules.Name: Company domains (edit me)
Rules.Description: Regex for your public and internal DNS domains, including every sub-domain.

Rules.Name: Server naming convention (edit me)
Rules.Description: Matches names such as PROD-SQL01, UAT_WEB2, DEVAPP003. Change it to match how your servers are named.

Rules.Name: Project code names (edit me)
Rules.Description: Exact text, one per line: internal project, programme or customer code names.

Rules.Name: Employee / customer id format (edit me)
Rules.Description: Example id formats like EMP-004512 or CUST12345678. Adjust to your own.

Rules.Name: Internal ticket references (edit me)
Rules.Description: Ticket keys from internal projects whose names are sensitive. Replace the keys with your own.

Rules.Name: Remove whole line containing a marker (edit me)
Rules.Description: Exact markers: the WHOLE line containing one of them is replaced (Scope = Line).
Rules.Example: // CONFIDENTIAL: pricing formula agreed with partner
